def transform(g):
    # collapse consecutive identical rows
    rows=[r for i,r in enumerate(g) if i==0 or r!=g[i-1]]
    # collapse consecutive identical columns
    t=list(map(list,zip(*rows)))
    cols=[c for j,c in enumerate(t) if j==0 or c!=t[j-1]]
    return [list(r) for r in zip(*cols)]
